on_calendar.source: LEAD-2127 section 5: rebuild C baselines each morning; ADR-0002 PRE starts 04:00 ET. Starting schedule one hour before PRE, not a measured completion-time guarantee; systemd.time calendar timezone syntax read 2026-11-10.

Fixture measurement, not production capacity.
